question: Area drops to about 45 FPS while scanning: shaders or CPU?
user_report: With cached shaders, almost no stutter in visited areas.
conclusion: CPU-bound on the GX consumer thread. Busy samples per second roughly double (295 vs 136) across GX__CallDisplayList/WalkDisplayList/OnDraw (x2.2), fifo::process (x2.6), GXApplyBPReg (x2), ExpandMappedAttribute<2> and memcpy. No single hotspot: the scan visor submits the scene again (object-ID and outline passes), so the GX work doubles. Not shaders, not GPU encode, not presentation.
options: Cache the expanded vertex data of display lists (static world geometry, the same lists drawn by several passes and frames), validated like GxDisplayListScanCache.
Spread display-list vertex expansion across worker threads.
Micro-optimise ExpandMappedAttribute and the memcpy-heavy push paths.
tools: scratchpad timeline2.py (per-second FPS and thread busy), gxprof.py (GX thread profile, slow vs normal seconds)
